entities.name: Tenihas
entities.description: Bloodchief of House Ghet in Malakir, mentor of Anowon, betrayed and killed by him.

entities.name: Anowon
entities.description: Tenihas's heir, the first son of House Ghet, accused of killing him.

entities.name: House Ghet
entities.description: The vampire house led by Tenihas.

entities.name: Famished gods
entities.description: Mysterious gods vampires anciently served per ancient texts.

events.summary: Tenihas mentored Anowon, who was fascinated by ancient texts on vampires' servitude to famished gods; Tenihas forbade exploring them, breeding animosity.
events.quote: Tenihas did not want Anowon to explore these ancient texts

events.summary: Tenihas was brutally murdered in his bedroom, his retinue slaughtered; a surviving witness accused Anowon.
events.quote: One night, Bloodchief Tenihas was brutally murdered in his bedroom.

events.summary: Anowon did not return home for many decades.
events.quote: Anowon did not return to his homeland for many decades

relations.note: Accused of killing him in a rage.
relations.quote: The only surviving witness accused Anowon of killing Tenihas in a fit of rage before vanishing.
Tenihas was the Bloodchief of House Ghet in Malakir
